title: 十四章 赌约
content_zh:
冉青墨来了。
掩面的薄纱破碎一半，随着山巅的微风隐隐可见其下绝美无暇的容颜。
一眼，仿若万年。
回过神，许元缓缓起身，眉头一点点的皱起。
除了她眸中的那一抹清淡一如初见，她身体的状态肉眼可见的狼狈。
持剑的右臂无力的垂着，那一袭黑色的衣袍碎了一大片，左膀的衣衫几乎完全破碎，露出吹弹可破的肌肤，几缕鲜血从臂膀处的伤口处溢出，如几条嫣红小蛇蔓延至指尖，不断滴下。
扫了一眼冉青墨脚下的那颗三四层楼高的巨大蛇头。
巨大的蛇头顶端长有七朵莲花，此刻已然绽放了六朵，栩栩如生。
思索一瞬，许元瞳孔猛地一缩。
他认出了眼前这头巨蟒。
七生蠎。
七生蠎可蜕皮重修七次，第七次可真正化形成人，修炼速度与人族彻底无异。
蛇妖中天然的王者，如果是她的话，倒是不难解释为何那只焱灵蟒会不顾一切的想要杀死他。
为什么她会死？
许元盯着七生蠎那双已然死气弥漫的巨大蛇瞳，一种荒谬、不羁情绪一点点的在心中蔓延。
姬清月她可是女主角啊！
对方在第七次蜕皮化形成人后，便会前往大炎皇朝，并在靖江城与剧情主角相遇。
为什么....
为什么在这个时间点，她就这么轻易的被冉青墨给宰了？
曾经熟知的剧情的齿轮已经因为他的到来悄然开始发生改变。

许元愣神间，蛇头上的黑衣女子握剑的手悄然的动了，随手挥下。
一道血光闪过在许元愣神间悄然划过，回神望去。
蛇头长有七朵莲花的顶端霎时出现了一道深深的血痕，随后一株血色小莲从那伤口中被凌空摄持了出来。
此物一出，一股庞然的血腥味便席卷了整个山巅。
蛇心莲。
准确说是六转蛇心莲，价值连城，《沧源》最顶级的炼药材料之一，可炼制金麟丹或者血灵转身丹。
金麟丹可作破境之用。
血灵转身丹则有安魂融身只用，也是许元现在最需要的东西，彻底将身体与意魂融为一体不留破绽。
但是此刻，许元已经没有心思想这些了。
在游玩《沧源》的过程中，许元很喜欢姬清月这位古灵精怪的小萝莉，但那也只是停留在对纸片人老婆的爱护。
相较于一个纸片人老婆的死亡，他现在更关心的是对方死亡所带来的的连锁反应会不会影响整个世界线剧情的走向。
绵延数万里的万兴山脉是大炎皇朝的西南边境，再往西便是一座名为古渊的绝地，数十个大大小小的异妖族群在其内联合组成了一个松散妖国。
姬清月便来自那里。
如今身份尊贵的蛇族公主被冉青墨一剑削了脑袋，妖国的妖皇会不会迫于蛇妖一族的压力，做出一些与原作剧情相悖的举动，许元心里完全没底。
不过，很快许元便发现自己完全没有必要想这么多。
因为他可能活不到那个时候。
剜出姬清月的蛇心莲后，那蛇头上的黑衣女子身形直接一软，顺着庞大的蟒头曲面便朝着地面滚来。
许元回神的一瞬立刻快步上前将女子滚落的娇躯接住，皱着眉头轻轻呼喊了两声：
“冉先生...冉先生？”
握着女子肩膀的手微微摇晃，许元试图将对方唤醒，但她那一双眸子却依旧紧紧的闭着。

经过与姬清月的一番激战，这位黑衣如墨的清淡女子也已然到达了油尽灯枯的地步。
渐渐的，
许元发现怀中女子微弱的呼吸逐渐急促，那残破面纱下露出的白皙肌肤变得绯红一片，黑袍下的胸脯快速的起伏，身体的体温也在肉眼可见的速度快速增高.......
看着冉青墨身体的变化，许元思绪瞬间闪过很多东西，但最终还是长长呼出了一口气。
他记得，七生蠎好像没有人们喜闻乐见的Yin毒。
所以，冉青墨这种状态应该是因为其他。
可能是在冉青墨在运炁疗伤，也可能是某种毒素发作的症状。
但不管是哪一种，如今的许元也都只能干看着。
上一世学过粗浅急救知识，明显是不可能治得了这一世的超人类。
只能默默等待他人决定自己命运的感觉并不好受。
如果冉青墨死去，或者在冉青墨运功疗伤的这段时间，姬清月的手下或者原身老爹的手下赶来，他都逃不过一个死字。
但他现在能做的只有等待。
许元将她的身体抱道了山巅之上的一个大树之下靠坐着，而他则静静的坐在她的身侧守护。
时间一分一秒的过去，初升的旭日已然高挂，冉青墨那面色潮红的状态却依旧没有褪去。
不知过了多久，在一片萧瑟的寒风中，冉青墨清淡的声音平缓的从身侧传了过来：
“你说的洞府，在哪？”
她醒了，但声音难掩虚弱。
许元闻言立刻侧眸看了一眼她的状态，回道：
“在悬天崖的下方。”
顿了顿，他又问道： “你的状态如何？”

“........”听到这个答案，冉青墨没有回答，又缓缓的闭上了眼睛。
她闭着眼眸，低声道： “许长天父亲的人快到了。”
听到这话的许元，瞳孔猛然一缩。
她的声音很轻，却仿佛如同炸弹般瞬间响彻了许元的脑海。
“你说什么？”
冉青墨闭着眼睛重复，声音听不出任何的情绪：
“许长天父亲的人快到了。”
心跳一点一点的加快，许元缓缓站起了身：
“还有多久？”
冉青墨轻声回道：
“不到半刻钟。”
半刻钟？
许元心神一震，深吸一口气，再次问道：
“你现在的身体如何？”
冉青墨靠在树根处，睁开眼睛瞥了许元一眼，不答反问：
“你好像很不安？为什么？我不会把你的事情说出去。”
许元眼神四下打量着山巅四周的云雾，强行稳住了开始动摇的心神，沉声说道：
“你不知道夺舍可以被验明出来么？”
“.......”
冉青墨盯着许元一脸不解。

看样子她只知道夺舍会有斥异症，而不知道还有手段能在斥异症结束后检测。
许元没有和冉青墨解释这方世界的设定，语速加快，再次问道：
“你现在的身体能御空么？”
冉青墨沉默，随后摇头：
“我..伤得很重。”
许元抬手用力揉了揉眉心，问道：
“那你为什么能感应到有人来了？”
冉青墨理所当然：
“肉身的伤，对意魂的印象并不大。”
许元没再说话，脑海中飞速的
思索着接下来的对策。
他该怎么办？
继续呆在这里，等待原身老爹手下赶到，然后开始演戏？
原身老爹的手下在这个时间点并不知道是冉青墨抓了原身，可以把屎盆子在姬清月的头上，说是冉青墨救了他，反正姬清月已经死无对证。
但问题是他根本没法演。
沧源中就提了一嘴许长天是个吃喝嫖赌样样精通的纨绔，根本没有细致描写行为习惯。
如果被发现不对，那他就只能等死。
无数的念头闪过，许元忽然认命般的长长呼出了一口气。
他侧眸瞥着靠坐树旁的黑衣女子：
“能走么？”

“.........”冉青墨眼神疑惑，不理解许元的问题。
“能走么？”许元重复，声音平淡。
冉青墨沉默片刻，摇头。
许元沉默着俯下身，捡起地上的蛇心莲塞入怀中，双手穿过冉青墨的腿弯和后背，在她略显诧异的目光中直接将她公主抱了起来。
冉青墨的身体宛若无骨，很轻，即便是这已经肾透支的公子哥也能轻松抱起。
“......”
空气安静一瞬。
虽然身受重伤，想杀一介普通认对冉青墨而言也依旧是易如反掌之事，但她却没有挣扎，被他抱在怀中，也只是平静的盯着对方。
冉青墨盯着自己，许元却没看冉青墨。
怀中抱着她，一边朝着悬天崖边走去，许元一边轻声问道：
“冉青墨，你想死么？”
冉青墨不理解许元的问题，但她不想死，所以摇了摇头。
许元余光瞥见，轻轻一笑：
“不想死就对了，我们继续呆在这里，被许长天老爹手下抓回去，只是早死和晚死的区别。”
说话间，许元已经抱着前面站立在了悬天崖的崖边。
距离那万丈深渊，仅有一步之遥。
冉青墨略微沉吟，似乎意识到许元想要做什么，声音略显疑惑：
“你...想要带着我跳下去？”
“不敢？”许元笑道。
冉青墨侧眸瞥了一眼那仙雾翻滚的深渊，目光像看一个傻子：

“可，这里是悬天崖。”
许元与她对视片刻，呵呵一笑：
“跳下去摔死，也总好过被相国府的人折磨致死，不是么？”
冉青墨认真想了想，对着许元点了点头：
“哦，那你跳吧。”
许元没有着急，而是看着冉青墨，笑着说道：
“冉青墨，我们打个赌好吗？”
冉青墨不理解为什么眼前的男人这么矫情，眼神清淡，点头：
“你说。”
许元笑道：
“如果我们能活下来，你欠我一个人情，得帮我做一件事。”
冉青墨又看了一眼下方的深渊：
“可我们活不下来。”
“我是指万一活下来了。”许元轻笑。
“.........”
冉青墨沉默片刻，缓缓蹦出来一句，声音低低的：
“为什么活下来我要欠你人情？”
“......”
许元哑然，生死时刻已经让他没了很多顾忌：
“如果能活下来，那必然是因为我那洞府救了我们，我觉得这个应该够你一个人情吧？”

冉青墨思索片刻，觉得他说的有道理，点了点头：..
如果活下来，我欠你一个人情。”
“记着你说的话。”
话音落下，
许元毫不犹豫的便向前迈出了一步。
女子掩面的清纱随风飘落，
世界的一切仿佛在此刻都安静，
飞梭在云雾间，五感仿佛在一点点的逝去，许元周身只剩了耳旁破空的风声以及怀中女子那温润柔软的体温.........
在云雾间不知多久，
他垂眸看了一眼已然闭眸等死的她。
他记得，
她的福缘似乎是93.
content_en:
Ran Qingmo is here.
The tulle covering her face was half broken, and with the breeze on the mountain top, the beautiful and flawless face underneath was faintly visible.
One glance seems like ten thousand years.
After coming back to his senses, Xu Yuan slowly stood up and frowned little by little.
Except for the lightness in her eyes that was still the same as when we first saw her, her body was in a miserable state that could be seen with the naked eye.
The right arm holding the sword hung weakly, and the black robe was torn into pieces. The clothes on the left arm were almost completely broken, revealing the skin that could be broken by a blow. A few strands of blood spilled from the wound on the arm, like a few small bright red snakes, spreading to the fingertips and dripping continuously.
He glanced at the huge snake head three or four stories high at Ran Qingmo's feet.
There are seven lotus flowers growing on the top of the huge snake head, and six of them are now blooming, lifelike.
After thinking for a moment, Xu Yuan's pupils shrank suddenly.
He recognized the giant python in front of him.
Seven-year-old oak.
The Seven-Life Locust can shed its skin and rebuild itself seven times. The seventh time it can truly transform into a human being, its cultivation speed is exactly the same as that of the human race.
If she were the natural king among snake demons, it would not be difficult to explain why the Yanling python would desperately want to kill him.
Why did she die?
Xu Yuan stared at Qisheng Li's huge snake eyes that were filled with death energy, and a kind of absurd and unruly emotion spread in his heart little by little.
Ji Qingyue is the heroine!
After the other party molts and becomes a human for the seventh time, he will go to the Great Yan Dynasty and meet the protagonist of the plot in Jingjiang City.
Why....
Why was she killed so easily by Ran Qingmo at this point in time?
The gears of the once-familiar plot have quietly begun to change with his arrival.
Xu Yuan was stunned. The hand of the woman in black on the snake's head that was holding the sword quietly moved, and she waved it down casually.
A flash of blood passed quietly through Xu Yuan's stunned mind, and he looked back.
A deep blood mark suddenly appeared on the top of the snake's head with seven lotus flowers, and then a small bloody lotus was captured from the wound.
As soon as this thing came out, a huge smell of blood swept across the entire mountain top.
Ophiopogon japonicus.
To be precise, it is the Six-turn Snake Heart Lotus, which is priceless and one of the top medicine-making materials in "Cangyuan". It can be used to refine the Golden Lin Pill or the Blood Spirit Turning Pill.
Jinlin Dan can be used to break through the realm.
The Blood Spirit Turning Pill can only be used to pacify the soul and merge with the body. It is also what Xu Yuan needs most now. It can completely integrate the body and soul without leaving any flaws.
But at this moment, Xu Yuan no longer had the mind to think about this.
While playing "Cangyuan", Xu Yuan fell in love with Ji Qingyue, an eccentric little lolita, but that was just his love for the Paper Man's wife.
Compared to the death of a paper man's wife, he is now more concerned about whether the chain reaction caused by the other party's death will affect the direction of the entire world line plot.
The Wanxing Mountains stretching for tens of thousands of miles is the southwest border of the Dayan Dynasty. Further to the west is a Jedi land called Guyuan, where dozens of large and small alien demon groups have united to form a loose demon kingdom.
Ji Qingyue is from there.
Now that the noble Snake Clan Princess had her head chopped off by Ran Qingmo's sword, Xu Yuan was completely unsure whether the Demon King of the Demon Kingdom would be forced by the Snake Demon Clan to do something that was contrary to the plot of the original work.
However, Xu Yuan soon realized that there was no need to think so much.
Because he may not live until that time.
After Ji Qingyue's snake heart lotus was dug out, the figure of the woman in black on the snake's head softened and rolled towards the ground along the curved surface of the huge python head.
The moment Xu Yuan came to his senses, he immediately stepped forward to catch the woman's falling body, frowned and softly shouted twice:
"Mr. Ran...Mr. Ran?"
The hand holding the woman's shoulder shook slightly, Xu Yuan tried to wake her up, but her eyes were still tightly closed.
After a fierce battle with Ji Qingyue, this ordinary woman in black and ink has reached the point where the oil is exhausted and the lamp is exhausted.situation.
gradually,
Xu Yuan noticed that the weak breathing of the woman in his arms gradually became faster, the fair skin exposed under the broken veil turned crimson, the chest under the black robe rose and fell rapidly, and the body temperature also increased rapidly at a speed visible to the naked eye...
Seeing the changes in Ran Qingmo's body, Xu Yuan's thoughts flashed through many things, but he finally let out a long breath.
He remembered that there seemed to be no poisonous poison that people liked.
Therefore, Ran Qingmo's state should be due to other reasons.
It could be that Ran Qingmo was using Qi to heal his injuries, or it could be a symptom of a toxin attack.
But no matter which one it is, Xu Yuan can only watch.
Having learned basic first aid knowledge in the previous life, it was obviously impossible to cure a super human in this life.
It feels uncomfortable to just wait silently for others to decide your fate.
If Ran Qingmo died, or if Ji Qingyue's men or his original father's men came while Ran Qingmo was recovering from his injuries, he would not be able to escape death.
But all he could do now was wait.
Xu Yuan carried her body to sit under a big tree on the top of the mountain, while he quietly sat beside her to protect her.
Time passed by, and the rising sun was already high, but Ran Qingmo's flushed face still did not fade away.
I don't know how long it took, but in the bleak cold wind, Ran Qingmo's light voice came gently from the side:
"Where is the cave you mentioned?"
She woke up, but her voice could not hide her weakness.
Upon hearing this, Xu Yuan immediately glanced sideways at her condition and replied:
"Below the Hanging Cliff."
After a pause, he asked again: "How is your condition?"
"..." After hearing this answer, Ran Qingmo did not answer and slowly closed his eyes.
She closed her eyes and whispered: "Xu Changtian's father's people are coming soon."
When Xu Yuan heard this, his pupils suddenly shrank.
Her voice was very soft, but it instantly resounded through Xu Yuan's mind like a bomb.
"What did you say?"
Ran Qingmo repeated with his eyes closed, no emotion could be heard in his voice:
"Xu Changtian's father's people are coming soon."
His heartbeat accelerated little by little, Xu Yuan slowly stood up:
"How much longer?"
Ran Qingmo replied softly:
"Less than half an hour."
Half an hour?
Xu Yuan was shocked, took a deep breath, and asked again:
"How is your health now?"
Ran Qingmo leaned against the root of the tree, opened his eyes and glanced at Xu Yuan, and asked instead:
"You seem upset? Why? I won't tell anything about you."
Xu Yuan looked around at the clouds and mists around the mountain top, forced himself to steady his mind that was beginning to waver, and said in a deep voice:
"Don't you know that body snatching can be proven?"
"...."
Ran Qingmo stared at Xu Yuan with a puzzled expression.
It seems that she only knows that there will be repulsion in the body, but she does not know that there is a way to detect the repulsion after the repulsion is over.
Xu Yuan did not explain the setting of this world to Ran Qingmo. He spoke faster and asked again:
"Can your current body control the air?"
Ran Qingmo was silent, then shook his head:
"I'm...hurt badly."
Xu Yuan raised his hand and rubbed his eyebrows vigorously, and asked:
"Then why can you sense someone coming?"
Ran Qingmo took it for granted:
"Injuries to the physical body have little impact on the mind and soul."
Xu Yuan didn't speak anymore, his mind was racing
Thinking about the next countermeasures.
What should he do?
Continue to stay here, wait for the original father's men to arrive, and then start acting?
The original man's father's men didn't know that it was Ran Qingmo who captured the original body at this point in time. They could put a basin of shit on Ji Qingyue's head and say that Ran Qingmo saved him. Anyway, Ji Qingyue was dead and there was no proof.
But the problem is that he can't act at all.
Cangyuanzhong mentioned that Xu Changtian is a foodie, drinker and prostitute.The dude who is proficient in everything has no detailed description of his behavior and habits.
If he is found to be wrong, he will have to wait for death.
Countless thoughts flashed through his mind, and Xu Yuan suddenly let out a long breath of resignation.
He glanced sideways at the woman in black sitting next to the tree:
"Can I leave?"
"..." Ran Qingmo looked confused, not understanding Xu Yuan's question.
"Can I leave?" Xu Yuan repeated, his voice flat.
Ran Qingmo was silent for a moment and shook his head.
Xu Yuan leaned down in silence, picked up the snake heart lotus on the ground and stuffed it into his arms. He put his hands through Ran Qingmo's legs and back, and directly hugged the princess while she looked at her with a slightly surprised look.
Ran Qingmo's body seemed boneless and so light that even the young man with kidney overdraft could easily pick him up.
"..."
The air was quiet for a moment.
Although she was seriously injured, it was still easy for Ran Qingmo to kill an ordinary person, but she did not struggle. She was held in his arms and just stared at him calmly.
Ran Qingmo stared at himself, but Xu Yuan did not look at Ran Qingmo.
Holding her in his arms and walking towards the cliff, Xu Yuan asked softly:
"Ran Qingmo, do you want to die?"
Ran Qingmo didn't understand Xu Yuan's question, but she didn't want to die, so she shook her head.
Xu Yuan caught a glimpse from the corner of his eye and smiled softly:
"It's okay if you don't want to die. If we continue to stay here and are captured by Father Xu Changtian's men, it's just the difference between dying early and dying late."
While he was talking, Xu Yuan was already standing on the edge of Xantian Cliff with his arms in front of him.
There is only one step away from the abyss.
Ran Qingmo pondered for a moment, seeming to realize what Xu Yuan wanted to do, and his voice sounded slightly confused:
"You...want to jump down with me?"
"Don't you dare?" Xu Yuan laughed.
Ran Qingmo glanced sideways at the abyss where the fairy mist rolled, as if looking at a fool:
"But, this is Hanging Cliff."
Xu Yuan looked at her for a moment and smiled:
"It's better to jump to death than to be tortured to death by people from the Prime Minister's Mansion, isn't it?"
Ran Qingmo thought carefully and nodded to Xu Yuan:
"Oh, then you can dance."
Xu Yuan was not anxious, but looked at Ran Qingmo and said with a smile:
"Ran Qingmo, can we make a bet?"
Ran Qingmo didn't understand why the man in front of him was so pretentious, his eyes were light, and he nodded:
"You said."
Xu Yuan smiled and said:
"If we survive, you owe me a favor and do something for me."
Ran Qingmo glanced at the abyss below again:
"But we won't survive."
"I mean in case you survive." Xu Yuan chuckled.
"..."
Ran Qingmo was silent for a moment, then slowly said something in a low voice:
"Why do I owe you a favor for surviving?"
"..."
Xu Yuan was speechless. The moment of life and death had left him with no worries:
"If we can survive, it must be because my cave saved us. I think this should be enough for you as a favor, right?"
Ran Qingmo thought for a moment and felt that what he said made sense, and nodded:...
If you survive, I owe you a favor. "
"Remember what you said. "
The words fell,
Xu Yuan took a step forward without hesitation.
The veil covering the woman's face fell in the wind,
Everything in the world seems to be quiet at this moment,
Flying among the clouds and mist, Xu Yuan's five senses seemed to be passing away little by little. All that was left in Xu Yuan's body was the sound of wind in his ears and the warm and soft body temperature of the woman in his arms...
I don’t know how long I have been in the clouds and mist,
He lowered his eyes and glanced at her who had closed her eyes and waited for death.
He remembers,
Her luck seems to be 93.
